brief:
The United Nations raised concerns Monday that Israel's military operation in the occupied West Bank city of Hebron could constitute ethnic cleansing, according to Al-Monitor. The operation was launched after a deadly attack by Palestinian gunmen in the area.

The warning reflects mounting international concern over the scope and conduct of Israeli military actions in Palestinian-controlled territories following the attack.
dek: Israel's military operation in the occupied West Bank city of Hebron, launched after a deadly attack by Palestinian gunmen, raises serious concerns of "ethnic cleansing", the United Nations warned Monday.
title: UN warns Israel's Hebron operation risks ethnic cleansing
